runtime: Optional Pybricks firmware, API documented for version 4.1
all_motor_output_axes: +Z in the LDraw model, toward the front
positive_direction: COUNTERCLOCKWISE, viewed from the output faces
phase_zero: All three crank output pins point right from their motor axes

mechanism.type: Three independent direct-drive crank-rocker four-bar linkages

reference_motion.phase_reference: one shared time-based scalar plus preset offsets
reference_motion.alignment_anchor: Keep A at its current phase, choose nearest equivalent B/C targets

controls.startup_RIGHT: Record manually set right-pointing zero; release before continuing
controls.stopped_RIGHT: Gently align, then accelerate and run
controls.moving_RIGHT: Ramp to rest, hold, and return to selection
controls.CENTER: Normal Pybricks program stop remains enabled

faults.motor_stalled: Brake all motors and end the program
